d: Tyrese Proctor put on a SHOW against the Dallas Mavericks, recording the first triple-double of his NBA career with 24 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists in the Cleveland Cavaliers’ 127-117 victory! The 22-year-old also set new career-highs in points (24) and assists (10), shooting 10-of-19 from the field while knocking down four three-pointers. With this historic performance, Proctor became the youngest Cavalier to record a triple-double since Darius Garland on January 12, 2022. The Cavaliers improved to 7-7 on the season, while the Mavericks fell to 7-6.
